# ADR-001: One role per host class

**Status:** Accepted
**Date:** 2026-07-01

## Context

Roles were mixed per host.

## Existing Primitives Audit

Nothing existing covers it.

## Decision

Each host class gets exactly one role.

## Alternatives Considered

- Tags — rejected, invisible in the inventory.

## Consequences

The inventory is the map.

## Wiring & Contract Changes

None.
